o: There are user settings (`~/.claude/settings.json`), shared project (`.claude/settings.json`) and local settings (`.claude/settings.local.json`), as well as company-managed policies
There is only one global file
Configuration is saved only in environment variables
Each command requires manual configuration
questions.e: Layered configuration allows for team standards, personal preferences, and corporate policies to prevail.
questions.q_es: ¿Qué jerarquía de configuración es correcta en Claude Code?

questions.q: Where to put conventions that apply only to the `frontend/` directory of a monorepo?
o: In a `CLAUDE.md` inside `frontend/`
In the root `.gitignore`
In the names of the branches
In a comment of the first repo file
questions.e: The CLAUDE.md in subdirectories are loaded when working on that part of the code.
questions.q_es: ¿Dónde colocar convenciones que aplican solo al directorio `frontend/` de un monorepo?

questions.q: A CI flow should use Claude Code to automatically review PRs. What is the recommended approach?
o: Run Claude Code in headless mode (or the GitHub Actions integration) with restricted permissions and structured output
Open a manual interactive session in each PR
Give full access without restrictions
Copy the diff to a web chat
questions.e: Non-interactive execution with bounded permissions is suitable for automation.
questions.q_es: Un flujo de CI debe usar Claude Code para revisar PRs automáticamente. ¿Cuál es el enfoque recomendado?

questions.q: A developer wants to package a reusable procedure (instructions + scripts) that Claude loads only when relevant. What should you create?
o: A Skill (folder with `SKILL.md` and associated resources)
A SessionStart hook that prints the entire procedure
A new model
a web server
questions.e: Skills use progressive disclosure: only their description occupies context until they are needed.
questions.q_es: Un desarrollador quiere empaquetar un procedimiento reutilizable (instrucciones + scripts) que Claude cargue solo cuando sea relevante. ¿Qué debe crear?

questions.q: What is especially useful for delegating a subagent to Claude Code?
o: For browsing or review tasks that generate a lot of intermediate context, returning only a summary to the main session
To increase keyboard typing speed
To avoid using git
To change the operating system language
questions.e: Context isolation keeps the main conversation clean.
questions.q_es: ¿Para qué es especialmente útil delegar a un subagente en Claude Code?

questions.q: Multiple developers must share the same MCP server configuration and project commands. To do?
o: Version `.mcp.json` and `.claude/` (shared settings, commands/skills, agents) in the repository
Send settings via chat to each person
Save it in each one's `settings.local.json`
Do not use configuration
questions.e: Versioned project configuration ensures consistency; the personal stuff goes in local files ignored by git.
questions.q_es: Varios desarrolladores deben compartir la misma configuración de servidores MCP y comandos del proyecto. ¿Qué hacer?

questions.q: What is the benefit of using git worktrees with Claude Code?
o: Run several sessions in parallel on different tasks without interfering with each other
Reduce price per token
Avoid having to make commits
Disable hooks
questions.e: Each worktree is an isolated working directory of the same repo, ideal for concurrent sessions.
questions.q_es: ¿Qué beneficio aporta usar git worktrees con Claude Code?

questions.q: A CLAUDE.md grew to 2,000 lines and Claude seems to ignore parts of it. What do you recommend?
o: Keep it concise with the essentials and move details to referenced files, skills or CLAUDE.md by subdirectory
Duplicate content to reinforce it
Write everything in capital letters
Remove it completely
questions.e: A focused and well-structured CLAUDE.md is easier to follow and consumes less context.
questions.q_es: Un CLAUDE.md creció a 2 000 líneas y Claude parece ignorar partes. ¿Qué recomiendas?

questions.q: An integration needs to extract contract fields to JSON that are inserted into a database. What best ensures compliance with the scheme?
o: Structured outputs/tool use strict with JSON Schema, more validation and error handling in the application
Request JSON in free text and use regex
Increase `max_tokens`
Use temperature 1
questions.e: Constrained decoding guarantees the scheme; Business validation remains the responsibility of the app.
questions.q_es: Una integración necesita extraer campos de contratos a JSON que se insertan en una base de datos. ¿Qué garantiza mejor la conformidad con el esquema?

questions.q: In an extract, some fields do not appear in the document. How to design the schema to avoid invented data?
o: Allow `null` or an explicit "not found" value and instruct not to infer missing values
Make all required fields null-free
Ask you to invent a plausible value
Remove optional fields
questions.e: If the schema requires filling, the model will tend to manufacture; allowing absence is more honest.
questions.q_es: En una extracción, algunos campos no aparecen en el documento. ¿Cómo diseñar el esquema para evitar datos inventados?

questions.q: How do you improve extraction accuracy on long documents with verifiable citations?
o: Ask for relevant citations from the document first and then base the answer on them (or use the citations function)
Ask for the answer without looking at the document
Summarize the document to one sentence before
Translate the document into another language
questions.e: Anchoring in quotes reduces hallucinations and makes verification easier.
questions.q_es: ¿Cómo se mejora la precisión de extracción en documentos largos con citas verificables?

questions.q: A production system prompt mixes roles, rules, user data, and unstructured examples. What is the priority improvement?
o: Structure it into delimited sections (e.g. XML tags) separating instructions, context, examples and variable data
Shorten it to one sentence
Move everything to user message
Add emojis
questions.e: The clear structure facilitates tracking, maintenance and prompt caching.
questions.q_es: Un prompt de sistema de producción mezcla rol, reglas, datos del usuario y ejemplos sin estructura. ¿Cuál es la mejora prioritaria?

questions.q: The few-shot examples of a prompt are almost identical to each other and the model overfits its format. What to correct?
o: Use diverse examples that cover relevant variations and edge cases
Use a single example repeated five times
Delete instructions
Increase temperature
questions.e: Diversity prevents the model from copying unwanted surface patterns.
questions.q_es: Los ejemplos few-shot de un prompt son casi idénticos entre sí y el modelo sobreajusta a su formato. ¿Qué corregir?

questions.q: What is good practice when versioning production prompts?
o: Treat them as code: version control, review and automated evaluation before deploying
Edit them directly in production without registration
Save them only in the computer's memory
Change the prompt every day randomly
questions.e: The prompt is part of the product: it requires traceability and regression testing.
questions.q_es: ¿Qué es una buena práctica al versionar prompts de producción?

questions.q: A classifier must return a label from a closed set. What is the most robust design?
o: Define an `enum` in the output schema and validate the tag, with a category of "other/uncertain"
Request the label in free text
Request an explanatory paragraph without a tag
Let the model invent new categories
questions.e: An enum restricts output; The "uncertain" option allows escalating ambiguous cases.
questions.q_es: Un clasificador debe devolver una etiqueta de un conjunto cerrado. ¿Cuál es el diseño más robusto?

questions.q: Why can including a brief reasoning field before the decision in a structured output improve accuracy?
o: Because it allows the model to reason before committing to the answer (order matters in generation)
Because it reduces the number of tokens
Because it disables hallucinations completely
It has no effect
questions.e: The model generates sequentially; reasoning first can improve the final decision. With extended thinking this happens natively.
questions.q_es: ¿Por qué incluir un campo de razonamiento breve antes de la decisión en una salida estructurada puede mejorar la precisión?

questions.q: One prompt asks “Be concise” and another “Explain in detail” in different sections. What problem is there and how to solve it?
o: Contradictory instructions; clear priorities or conditions must be defined (e.g. concise unless detailed is requested)
None, the model chooses randomly and is fine
It is resolved by raising the temperature
It is solved with streaming
questions.e: Contradictions generate inconsistent behavior; must be explicitly reconciled.
questions.q_es: Un prompt pide «Sé conciso» y otro «Explica en detalle» en distintas secciones. ¿Qué problema hay y cómo resolverlo?

questions.q: What is the most reliable way to measure whether structured output meets business requirements (not just format)?
o: Evals with tagged cases that validate field values in addition to schema validity
Trust that if the JSON is valid it is correct
Review a single example
Measure latency
questions.e: A valid JSON may contain erroneous values; accuracy of content is evaluated.
questions.q_es: ¿Cuál es la forma más fiable de medir si la salida estructurada cumple requisitos de negocio (no solo de formato)?

questions.q: A support chatbot with very long conversations starts to exceed the context window. What strategy do you recommend?
o: Compaction/summarization of old shifts and selective retrieval of relevant information (e.g. RAG or memory)
Truncate the system prompt
Increase `max_tokens`
Restart the conversation without warning
questions.e: Context management preserves what is essential and discards what is irrelevant, maintaining behavior.
questions.q_es: Un chatbot de soporte con conversaciones muy largas empieza a superar la ventana de contexto. ¿Qué estrategia recomiendas?

questions.q: What is the phenomenon of degradation in very long contexts ("context rot")?
o: Accuracy in retrieving or using information may decrease as context grows with less relevant content
The model randomly deletes messages
Tokens expire after 5 minutes
API rejects prompts with more than 1,000 tokens
questions.e: Context is a finite resource: more is not always better; It is advisable to cure what comes in.
questions.q_es: ¿Qué es el fenómeno de degradación en contextos muy largos («context rot»)?

questions.q: A RAG application returns incorrect answers because it retrieves irrelevant fragments. What improvement is priority?
o: Improve retrieval (chunking, hybrid search, reranking, contextual retrieval) and evaluate it separately
Upgrade to a larger model without touching recovery
Increase temperature
Delete appointments
questions.e: If the recovered context is bad, the model cannot compensate for it; recovery and generation are evaluated separately.
questions.q_es: Una aplicación de RAG devuelve respuestas incorrectas porque recupera fragmentos poco relevantes. ¿Qué mejora es prioritaria?

questions.q: How do you design an application to be resilient against API 429/529 errors?
o: Retries with exponential backoff and jitter, queues, concurrency limits and, if applicable, fallback to another model or region
Retry immediately in infinite loop
Ignore errors
Increase `max_tokens`
questions.e: Standard resilience patterns avoid storms of retries and degrade gracefully.
questions.q_es: ¿Cómo se diseña una aplicación resiliente frente a errores 429/529 de la API?

questions.q: An agent in production occasionally produces unexpected actions. What ability is essential to diagnose it?
o: Observability: securely record prompts, tool calls, results and decisions (traces)
Disable all logs to protect privacy
Change models randomly
Reduce tools to zero
questions.e: The traces allow the behavior to be reproduced and understood; Sensitive data is protected.
questions.q_es: Un agente en producción ocasionalmente produce acciones inesperadas. ¿Qué capacidad es esencial para diagnosticarlo?

questions.q: To reduce costs on an assistant with a manual of 50,000 tokens sent with each consultation, what do you recommend?
o: Place the manual in a stable prefix with prompt caching or retrieve only relevant sections
Send the manual twice for accuracy
Switch to streaming
Delete the system prompt
questions.e: The cache reduces cost and latency of the repeated prefix; RAG reduces the volume shipped.
questions.q_es: Para reducir costos en un asistente con un manual de 50 000 tokens enviado en cada consulta, ¿qué recomiendas?

questions.q: Which practice improves reliability when upgrading to a new model version?
o: Pin specific model versions, run the evals suite, and gradually deploy
Always use an untested alias
Change all prompts at once without evaluating
Deploy directly to 100%
questions.e: New models can change behaviors; evals and gradual rollouts detect regressions.
questions.q_es: ¿Qué práctica mejora la confiabilidad cuando se actualiza a una nueva versión de modelo?

questions.q: A long-running agent works in multiple context windows. What technique makes it easier to get back to work?
o: Persist progress on artifacts (status file, tests, git commits) that the new session reads on startup
Trust the model to remember between sessions
Always start from scratch
Duplicate the system prompt
questions.e: Verifiable external state (progress, tests, git history) allows continuity between context windows.
questions.q_es: Un agente de larga duración trabaja en múltiples ventanas de contexto. ¿Qué técnica facilita retomar el trabajo?

questions.q: What is “augmented LLM”, the basic block of agentic systems?
o: An LLM enhanced with information retrieval, tools and memory
An LLM with more parameters
An LLM without a system prompt
An LLM run on multiple GPUs
questions.e: Workflows and agents are built by combining LLMs with retrieval, tools and memory.
questions.q_es: ¿Qué es el «LLM aumentado», bloque básico de los sistemas agénticos?

questions.q: In a prompt chaining pipeline, what are the “gates” between steps for?
o: To programmatically check the output of a step before continuing (e.g. validate format or criteria)
To increase the temperature
To cache responses
To encrypt the prompt
questions.e: Intermediate checks detect errors early and prevent them from propagating.
questions.q_es: En un pipeline de prompt chaining, ¿para qué sirven las «compuertas» (gates) entre pasos?

questions.q: A support agent should only issue refunds to verified customers. Where is that rule most reliably applied?
o: In the code of the refund tool (deterministic precondition), in addition to mentioning it in the prompt
Only at the system prompt
In the product description
Trusting the client to tell the truth
questions.e: Critical business rules are enforced in code; The prompt guides, but does not guarantee.
questions.q_es: Un agente de soporte solo debe emitir reembolsos a clientes verificados. ¿Dónde se aplica esa regla con mayor fiabilidad?

questions.q: An agent can retry the `create_order` tool after a timeout and generate duplicate orders. What design prevents this?
o: Make the operation idempotent (e.g. with an idempotent key)
Ban retries entirely
Increase timeout to one hour
Ask the model to remember if it has already been created
questions.e: Idempotence makes retries safe, which are inevitable in distributed systems.
questions.q_es: Un agente puede reintentar la herramienta `crear_pedido` tras un timeout y generar pedidos duplicados. ¿Qué diseño lo evita?

questions.q: What does Anthropic recommend regarding the use of agent frameworks?
o: Start by using the API directly and, if using a framework, understand the underlying code
Always use the most complex framework available
Never use the API directly
Avoid understanding internal prompts
questions.e: Abstractions can hide prompts and responses, making it difficult to debug.
questions.q_es: ¿Qué recomienda Anthropic respecto al uso de frameworks de agentes?

questions.q: A support agent receives a refund request of $5,000 when the policy authorizes up to $500. What is the correct behavior?
o: Escalate to a human with a case summary, rather than approving or rejecting on your own
Approve it to satisfy the customer
Split it into 10 refunds of 500 USD
Ignore the request
questions.e: Policy exceptions require escalation with structured context.
questions.q_es: Un agente de soporte recibe una solicitud de reembolso de 5 000 USD cuando la política autoriza hasta 500 USD. ¿Cuál es el comportamiento correcto?

questions.q: When should subagents run sequentially instead of in parallel?
o: When the output of one is necessary input for the next
Always, parallelism is not possible
When subtasks are independent
When you want to reduce total latency
questions.e: The dependencies determine the order; independent tasks are parallelized.
questions.q_es: ¿Cuándo deben ejecutarse subagentes de forma secuencial en lugar de en paralelo?

questions.q: Why is “ground truth” important in every step of an agent?
o: Because it allows the agent to evaluate their progress with real results (tool outputs, tests) and correct course
Because it reduces the price per token
Because it avoids having to define tools
It's not important
questions.e: Agents perform best when they can verify real results in each iteration.
questions.q_es: ¿Por qué es importante la «retroalimentación del entorno» (ground truth) en cada paso de un agente?

questions.q: Select the TWO conditions that justify adding a human checkpoint on an agent.
o: The action is irreversible or high impact (payments, deletions, external shipments)
Agent has low confidence or faces a policy exception
The action is a read of public data
The agent checks the current time
The result will be used only internally as a draft
questions.e: The level of supervision is adjusted to the risk of the action.
questions.q_es: Selecciona las DOS condiciones que justifican añadir un checkpoint humano en un agente.

questions.q: Select the THREE techniques that control the cost and duration of an agent.
o: Maximum iteration/turn limit
Token budget or cost per task
Timeouts per tool and per completed task
High temperature
Delete the logs
questions.e: Explicit limits prevent loops and runaway spending.
questions.q_es: Selecciona las TRES técnicas que controlan costo y duración de un agente.

questions.q: Select the TWO benefits of subagent context isolation.
o: The main conversation is not filled with intermediate results
Each subagent can focus on their task with specific instructions
Subagents automatically share all orchestrator memory
Token costs eliminated
Determinism is guaranteed
questions.e: Isolation improves focus; That is why the delegation must include all the necessary context.
questions.q_es: Selecciona las DOS ventajas del aislamiento de contexto de los subagentes.

questions.q: Select the TWO appropriate situations for the routing pattern.
o: Easy queries for a small model and complex queries for a more capable one
Tickets of different categories that require different prompts and tools
A single task without variants
Iteratively refine a text with an evaluator
Break a task into fixed sequential steps
questions.e: Routing classifies the input and directs it to a specialized stream.
questions.q_es: Selecciona las DOS situaciones adecuadas para el patrón de routing.

questions.q: Select the TWO signs that an autonomous agent is NOT the best option.
o: The steps are fixed and known in advance
Latency and cost requirements are very strict
The task is open and the number of steps is unpredictable
There is an environment with verifiable feedback
Flexibility is needed to use different tools
questions.e: Workflows are cheaper, faster and more predictable when the task is well defined.
questions.q_es: Selecciona las DOS señales de que un agente autónomo NO es la mejor opción.

questions.q: An agent uses MCP servers from Jira and GitHub, and both have a `search` tool. What improvement do you recommend?
o: Namespaces in tool names (e.g. `jira_search`, `github_search`) with descriptions that delimit their scope
Delete one of the two servers
Let the model guess
Rename them `search1` and `search2`
questions.e: Per-service prefixes reduce confusion between similar tools.
questions.q_es: Un agente usa servidores MCP de Jira y GitHub, y ambos tienen una herramienta `search`. ¿Qué mejora recomiendas?

questions.q: What is the point of providing a `response_format` parameter (e.g. `concise` | `detailed`) in a tool?
o: For the agent to control the verbosity of the result and save context when it does not need details
To change the model language
To encrypt the response
To avoid network errors
questions.e: Giving the agent control over the amount of information returned improves token efficiency.
questions.q_es: ¿Para qué sirve ofrecer un parámetro `response_format` (p. ej. `concise` | `detailed`) en una herramienta?

questions.q: What are tool annotations in MCP (e.g. `readOnlyHint`, `destructiveHint`)?
o: Metadata that describes the behavior of the tool so that the client can decide how to present it or whether it requires confirmation
Server source code comments
Access credentials
Temperature parameters
questions.e: They are clues for the client; They are not a substitute for actual security checks.
questions.q_es: ¿Qué son las anotaciones de herramientas en MCP (p. ej. `readOnlyHint`, `destructiveHint`)?

questions.q: An agent needs to search for current information on the internet. Which option is usually more efficient to implement?
o: Use the web search server tool offered by the platform
Build your own crawler from scratch
Ask the model to remember news
Manually paste search results
questions.e: Integrated tools reduce construction and maintenance effort.
questions.q_es: Un agente necesita buscar información actual en internet. ¿Qué opción suele ser más eficiente de implementar?

questions.q: An agent has access to more than 100 tools and their definition consumes much of the context. What approach helps?
o: Load tools on demand using tool search instead of always including all
Include all definitions twice
Delete descriptions
Increase temperature
questions.e: Lazy loading of tools reduces the context consumed and improves selection.
questions.q_es: Un agente tiene acceso a más de 100 herramientas y su definición consume gran parte del contexto. ¿Qué enfoque ayuda?

questions.q: Select the TWO characteristics of a good error message returned by a tool.
o: Indicates what went wrong and how to correct the call
Distinguishes retryable errors (timeout) from non-retryable errors (permission denied)
It only returns a numeric code
Includes the complete stack trace with credentials
It always says "unknown error"
questions.e: Actionable errors allow the agent to recover or scale correctly.
questions.q_es: Selecciona las DOS características de un buen mensaje de error devuelto por una herramienta.

questions.q: Select the THREE MCP primitives and who typically controls them.
o: Tools – controlled by the model
Resources – controlled by the application
Prompts – user controlled
Models – controlled by the server
Tokens – controlled by the host
questions.e: Each primitive has a different control model that guides its use.
questions.q_es: Selecciona las TRES primitivas de MCP y quién las controla típicamente.

questions.q: Select TWO security practices when exposing a database using MCP.
o: Separate read-only tools from write-only tools
Use least privilege database credentials
Expose a tool that executes arbitrary SQL with administrator user
Disable authentication on the internal network
Include the password in the tool description
questions.e: Least privilege and separation of capabilities limit the impact of errors or attacks.
questions.q_es: Selecciona las DOS prácticas de seguridad al exponer una base de datos mediante MCP.

questions.q: Select the TWO correct statements about the tool descriptions.
o: They should explain when to use the tool and when not to.
May include examples of valid entries
They should be as short as possible, ideally one word
They do not influence model selection
They must contain secrets to authenticate
questions.e: The description is the main input of the model to choose and use the tool.
questions.q_es: Selecciona las DOS afirmaciones correctas sobre las descripciones de herramientas.

questions.q: You want to automatically load the list of tickets for the current sprint at the beginning of each Claude Code session. What hook do you use?
o: `SessionStart`
`PostToolUse`
`Stop`
`PreCompact`
questions.e: SessionStart can inject dynamic context when starting the session.
questions.q_es: Quieres cargar automáticamente al inicio de cada sesión de Claude Code la lista de tickets del sprint actual. ¿Qué hook usas?

questions.q: You want to prevent Claude Code from terminating a task if the tests fail. Which hook is suitable?
o: A `Stop` hook that runs the tests and blocks completion if they fail
A `SessionStart` hook
A `UserPromptSubmit` hook that clears the prompt
No hook can do it
questions.e: The Stop hook is executed when Claude is about to finish and can demand that he continue.
questions.q_es: Quieres impedir que Claude Code dé por terminada una tarea si los tests fallan. ¿Qué hook es adecuado?

questions.q: How do I include the contents of another file within a CLAUDE.md?
o: With the import syntax `@path/to/file`
With `#include`
Always copying it manually
With `import file from`
questions.e: Imports allow the project memory to be modularized.
questions.q_es: ¿Cómo se incluye el contenido de otro archivo dentro de un CLAUDE.md?

questions.q: Where do you put personal preferences that you want to apply in all your projects with Claude Code?
o: In `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` (user memory)
In the CLAUDE.md of each team repository
In `.mcp.json`
In the project README
questions.e: User memory applies to all projects without affecting other team members.
questions.q_es: ¿Dónde colocas preferencias personales que quieres aplicar en todos tus proyectos con Claude Code?

questions.q: In a CI pipeline you want to limit how many agentic turns Claude Code can execute in headless mode. What option do you use?
o: `--max-turns`
`--max-tokens-global`
`--timeout-days`
`--no-agent`
questions.e: Limiting shifts limits cost and duration in automations.
questions.q_es: En un pipeline de CI quieres limitar cuántos turnos agénticos puede ejecutar Claude Code en modo headless. ¿Qué opción usas?

questions.q: Select TWO best practices for code reviews with Claude Code.
o: Use a separate instance or subagent (clean context) to review what another instance wrote
Provide explicit review criteria (security, style, testing)
Ask the same session to self-approve without criteria
Check only file names
Disable tests during review
questions.e: A reviewer with independent context and clear criteria detects more problems.
questions.q_es: Selecciona las DOS prácticas recomendadas para revisiones de código con Claude Code.

questions.q: Select the TWO steps of the TDD flow with Claude Code.
o: Write the tests first and confirm that they fail
Deploy the code until the tests pass without modifying the tests
Write code and then remove failing tests
Ask Claude to adjust the tests so that they pass
Avoid running tests
questions.e: Tests act as a verifiable objective and avoid “cheating” solutions.
questions.q_es: Selecciona los DOS pasos del flujo TDD con Claude Code.

questions.q: Select all THREE valid configuration/memory locations in Claude Code.
o: `CLAUDE.md` in the project root
`.claude/settings.json` from the project
user's `~/.claude/settings.json`
`/etc/hosts`
`package-lock.json`
questions.e: Layered configuration combines team standards and personal preferences.
questions.q_es: Selecciona las TRES ubicaciones válidas de configuración/memoria en Claude Code.

questions.q: Select the TWO forms of Claude Code output in headless mode useful for integrations.
o: `--output-format json`
`--output-format stream-json`
`--output-format docx`
`--output-format mp3`
`--output-format html-gui`
questions.e: JSON for a final parseable result; stream-json to process events in real time.
questions.q_es: Selecciona las DOS formas de salida de Claude Code en modo headless útiles para integraciones.

questions.q: Select the TWO situations where it is appropriate to use plan mode.
o: A large refactor that affects many files
Explore an unknown codebase before changing it
Fix a typo in a comment
Rename a local variable
Run a trivial read command
questions.e: Planning first is valuable when the scope or risk is high.
questions.q_es: Selecciona las DOS situaciones donde conviene usar plan mode.

questions.q: An extraction to JSON fails business validation (e.g. an impossible date). Which pattern improves the success rate?
o: Validation and retry loop: return the specific error to the model and request the correction
Retry with the same prompt without error information
Accept the value and always correct it manually
Increase temperature
questions.e: Concrete feedback allows for self-correction; The number of retries is limited.
questions.q_es: Una extracción a JSON falla la validación de negocio (p. ej. una fecha imposible). ¿Qué patrón mejora la tasa de éxito?

questions.q: An invoice has a variable number of detail lines. How is it modeled in the schematic?
o: Like an array of objects, each with its fields (description, quantity, price)
As a single string with all the text
Like 50 fixed fields `line1`…`line50`
Cannot be modeled
questions.e: Arrays of objects represent collections of variable length.
questions.q_es: Una factura tiene un número variable de líneas de detalle. ¿Cómo se modela en el esquema?

questions.q: Documents from different sources use dates in different formats. What do you do in the prompt/schema?
o: Specify a standardized output format (e.g. ISO 8601 `YYYY-MM-DD`) and validate it
Accept any format
Request the date in free text
Delete dates
questions.e: Normalization makes post-processing and validation easier.
questions.q_es: Documentos de distintas fuentes usan fechas en formatos diferentes. ¿Qué haces en el prompt/esquema?

questions.q: An application processes text provided by users within a prompt with instructions. How to reduce the risk of this text being interpreted as instructions?
o: Delimit user content with labels and declare in the prompt that it is information to be analyzed, not instructions
Mix user text with instructions
Put user text at the system prompt
Delete all instructions
questions.e: Clear separation between instructions and data is a basic defense (not sufficient on its own).
questions.q_es: Una aplicación procesa texto proporcionado por usuarios dentro de un prompt con instrucciones. ¿Cómo reducir el riesgo de que ese texto se interprete como instrucciones?

questions.q: You want questionable extractions to go to human review. What design makes it easier?
o: Include a trust or “requires review” field with defined criteria and route based on threshold
Ask that you never express doubts
Always review everything manually
Discard difficult documents
questions.e: Explicit signals of uncertainty allow human review to be prioritized.
questions.q_es: Quieres que las extracciones dudosas pasen a revisión humana. ¿Qué diseño lo facilita?

questions.q: Select the TWO JSON Schema properties useful for strict output.
o: `required` for required fields
`additionalProperties: false` to prevent undefined fields
`randomize: true`
`temperature` inside the schema
`allowHallucinations: false`
questions.e: These constraints precisely define the valid form of the output.
questions.q_es: Selecciona las DOS propiedades de JSON Schema útiles para salidas estrictas.

questions.q: Select the TWO practices to summarize multiple documents with traceability.
o: Wrap each document with tags and metadata (source, date)
Ask each statement to indicate which document it comes from.
Concatenate all documents without separation
Remove font names
Request a summary without references
questions.e: The structure and citations by source allow the synthesis to be verified.
questions.q_es: Selecciona las DOS prácticas para resumir varios documentos con trazabilidad.

questions.q: Select THREE ways to control the output length.
o: Indicate explicit limits (e.g. “maximum 5 vignettes”)
Set `max_tokens` as security limit
Show an example with the desired length
Increase temperature
Repeat the question
questions.e: Instructions, examples and technical limits complement each other; `max_tokens` cuts but does not summarize.
questions.q_es: Selecciona las TRES formas de controlar la longitud de la salida.

questions.q: Select the TWO common causes of inconsistent output in production.
o: Ambiguous or contradictory instructions in the prompt
Unrepresentative few-shot examples
Use XML tags
Use an output schema
Version the prompts
questions.e: Ambiguity and poor examples are common sources of variability.
questions.q_es: Selecciona las DOS causas comunes de salidas inconsistentes en producción.

questions.q: Select the TWO advantages of structured output over free text parsing.
o: Guaranteed compliance with the defined scheme
Less fragile parsing (regex) code in the application
They guarantee that the values are true
Eliminate the need to evaluate
They reduce the price to zero
questions.e: The structure is guaranteed; The accuracy of the content still requires validation and evals.
questions.q_es: Selecciona las DOS ventajas de las salidas estructuradas frente al parseo de texto libre.

questions.q: When summarizing a long support conversation, the order number and amounts are lost. What design prevents this?
o: Maintain a persistent block of “case facts” (IDs, amounts, dates) outside the summary and always included in the context
Summarize more aggressively
Delete entire history
Trust the model to remember
questions.e: Critical data is explicitly preserved; summaries tend to miss precise details.
questions.q_es: Al resumir una conversación larga de soporte, se pierden el número de pedido y los montos. ¿Qué diseño lo evita?

questions.q: What is the "lost in the middle" effect?
o: Information in the middle of long contexts may be used less reliably than information at the beginning or end.
The model loses internet connection
Middle tokens are not billed
The model deletes the center of the prompt
questions.e: Placing the critical at the beginning or end, and summarizing key findings, mitigates the effect.
questions.q_es: ¿Qué es el efecto «lost in the middle»?

questions.q: A tool that the agent depends on is down. What is the desired behavior?
o: Controlled degradation: report limitation, deliver partial results marked as such, or escalate
Invent the result of the tool
Retry indefinitely
End without reporting anything
questions.e: Transparency about failures avoids misleading responses.
questions.q_es: Una herramienta de la que depende el agente está caída. ¿Cuál es el comportamiento deseado?

questions.q: What pattern protects a system when an external dependency fails repeatedly?
o: Circuit breaker: temporarily stop calling dependency and gradually recover
Double the number of calls
Eliminate timeouts
Reboot all servers every minute
questions.e: Avoid saturating a downed service and speed up error response.
questions.q_es: ¿Qué patrón protege un sistema cuando una dependencia externa falla repetidamente?

questions.q: Select the TWO practices for maintaining provenance in multi-source synthesis systems.
o: Preserve source metadata (URL/document, date) along with each finding
Require that final statements reference their source
Delete fonts to save tokens
Combine everything in a text without references
Trust model memory
questions.e: Provenance allows you to verify and resolve conflicts between sources.
questions.q_es: Selecciona las DOS prácticas para mantener la procedencia en sistemas de síntesis multi-fuente.

questions.q: Select the TWO correct ways to define escalation criteria to human.
o: Explicit rules (e.g. amount > limit, customer request to speak to a person)
Policy exceptions or cases outside the defined scope
Only when the client uses negative words
Randomly
Never, to maximize automation
questions.e: Explicit criteria are more reliable than heuristics such as sentiment.
questions.q_es: Selecciona las DOS formas correctas de definir criterios de escalamiento a humano.

questions.q: Select the TWO techniques that reduce noise in the context of an agent.
o: Clip tool results to relevant fields
Delete or compact old results that are no longer needed
Include complete debug logs in each shift
Repeat the system prompt in each message
Add unrelated documents “just in case”
questions.e: Curated context improves accuracy and reduces costs.
questions.q_es: Selecciona las DOS técnicas que reducen el ruido en el contexto de un agente.

questions.q: Select the TWO practices to detect quality degradation in production over time.
o: Periodically rerun the eval suite, including recent production samples
Monitor user signals (feedback, escalations, retries)
Check CPU usage only
Wait for formal complaints
Turn off interaction logging
questions.e: Continuous monitoring detects changes in data, usage or behavior.
questions.q_es: Selecciona las DOS prácticas para detectar degradación de calidad en producción a lo largo del tiempo.

CCAR-P.title: Claude Certified Architect, Professional
CCAR-P.desc: Advanced simulation of scenarios: multi-platform enterprise deployments, security and governance, multi-agent systems, scale evaluation and efficient operation in production.

questions.q: A bank requires all AI traffic to remain within its existing AWS cloud account with unified IAM billing and controls. What option do you recommend?
o: Consume Claude via Amazon Bedrock
Using personal Claude.ai accounts
Download the model weights and install them on-premise
Use a free public proxy
questions.e: Bedrock offers Claude integrated with IAM, VPC endpoints, CloudTrail, and AWS billing.
questions.q_es: Un banco exige que todo el tráfico de IA permanezca dentro de su cuenta cloud existente en AWS con facturación y controles IAM unificados. ¿Qué opción recomiendas?

questions.q: A standardized organization on Google Cloud needs Claude with regional data residency. Which platform is natural?
o: Google Cloud Vertex AI, choosing available regional endpoints
Direct API only with no regional options
A local MCP server
Claude Code in headless mode
questions.e: Vertex AI allows you to consume Claude within GCP with regional controls and Google IAM.
questions.q_es: Una organización estandarizada en Google Cloud necesita Claude con residencia de datos regional. ¿Qué plataforma es natural?

questions.q: When migrating an app from Anthropic Direct API to Bedrock, what typically changes?
o: Authentication (AWS credentials instead of `x-api-key`), model IDs, and availability of some beta features
Nothing, everything is identical including the model IDs
The format of the prompts must be translated into another language
You have to retrain the model
questions.e: Anthropic SDKs have clients for Bedrock/Vertex; but IDs, auth and availability of features may vary by platform.
questions.q_es: Al migrar una app de la API directa de Anthropic a Bedrock, ¿qué suele cambiar?

questions.q: A company with 5,000 employees wants to deploy Claude.ai in a governed manner. What elements are priorities?
o: SSO/SCIM, management roles, retention policies, audit logs, and connector control
Create personal accounts for each employee with their own cards
Allow any connector without review
Turn off authentication for easier access
questions.e: Enterprise plans provide centralized identity, data auditing and governance, and integrations.
questions.q_es: Una empresa de 5 000 empleados quiere desplegar Claude.ai de forma gobernada. ¿Qué elementos son prioritarios?

questions.q: To deploy Claude Code to hundreds of developers with homogeneous policies that cannot be modified by the user, what mechanism do you use?
o: Managed settings/policies that take precedence over user and project settings
A CLAUDE.md in each repository asking that the rules be respected
An email with recommendations
Optional environment variables
questions.e: Managed policies centrally enforce permissions, allowed MCP servers, and other restrictions.
questions.q_es: Para desplegar Claude Code a cientos de desarrolladores con políticas homogéneas no modificables por el usuario, ¿qué mecanismo usas?

questions.q: A client wants to route Claude Code traffic through their corporate LLM gateway for registration and cost control. Is it viable?
o: Yes; Claude Code can be configured to use a gateway/proxy or Bedrock/Vertex endpoints using environment and configuration variables
No, Claude Code only works with the public API without intermediaries
Only if TLS is disabled
Only on Linux
questions.e: Claude Code supports cloud providers and corporate LLM gateways to centralize auth, logs and budgets.
questions.q_es: Un cliente quiere enrutar el tráfico de Claude Code a través de su gateway LLM corporativo para registro y control de costos. ¿Es viable?

questions.q: An internal assistant is designed that requires data from Salesforce, Jira and a data warehouse. Which integration approach scales best?
o: MCP servers (reusable between clients) with authentication and permissions scope per system
Copy daily CSV exports at the prompt
Different ad hoc integrations for each client application
Give the model administrator credentials at the prompt
questions.e: MCP standardizes integrations and allows them to be reused in Claude.ai, Claude Code and your own agents.
questions.q_es: Se diseña un asistente interno que necesita datos de Salesforce, Jira y un data warehouse. ¿Qué enfoque de integración escala mejor?

questions.q: A global app requires high availability in the event of incidents from a provider or region. What architecture do you recommend?
o: Provider abstraction with failover between direct API, Bedrock and/or Vertex, with evals that validate parity
A single endpoint with no retries
Manually change the code during an incident
Duplicate requests to all suppliers always
questions.e: Multi-vendor with automated failover improves resilience; equivalent behavior is validated.
questions.q_es: Una app global requiere alta disponibilidad ante incidentes de un proveedor o región. ¿Qué arquitectura recomiendas?

questions.q: What criteria should guide the choice of model per use case in a business portfolio?
o: Quality/latency/cost ratio measured with case-specific evaluations, not a one-size-fits-all choice
Always use the largest model
Always use the cheapest
Choose by popularity on social networks
questions.e: Different cases (triage, deep analysis, agents) justify different models.
questions.q_es: ¿Qué criterio debe guiar la elección de modelo por caso de uso en un portafolio empresarial?

questions.q: A customer wants an agent to work in isolated environments with code and file execution, managed by the platform. What type of solution to evaluate?
o: Managed agent services/code execution in platform sandbox, or the Agent SDK on your own isolated containers
Run generated code directly on production servers
Ask the user to run everything manually
Disable code execution and simulate it at the prompt
questions.e: Isolated execution (sandbox/containers) contains risks and makes it easier to scale agents.
questions.q_es: Un cliente quiere que un agente trabaje en entornos aislados con ejecución de código y archivos, gestionado por la plataforma. ¿Qué tipo de solución evaluar?

questions.q: An agent reads incoming mail and can send responses. What is the main risk and its mitigation?
o: Indirect prompt injection in emails; treat content as data, limit tools, and require approval for submissions
That the emails are in HTML; converting to text solves everything
The model is too slow
None if 0 temperature is used
questions.e: Untrustworthy content may contain instructions; the defense is layered: least privilege, isolation, and human confirmation.
questions.q_es: Un agente lee correos entrantes y puede enviar respuestas. ¿Cuál es el riesgo principal y su mitigación?

questions.q: Which combination is especially dangerous in an agent (the "lethal trifecta")?
o: Access to private data + exposure to untrusted content + ability to communicate externally
Streaming + cache + batch
Low temperature + high max_tokens + system prompt
Using JSON + XML + Markdown
questions.e: Together they allow data to be exfiltrated via prompt injection; At least one of the three elements must be broken.
questions.q_es: ¿Qué combinación es especialmente peligrosa en un agente (la «trifecta letal»)?

questions.q: A healthcare client asks about the use of their data. Which statement is appropriate for business plans/APIs?
o: By default, Anthropic does not train models with commercial customer data; Agreements such as DPA and, if applicable, BAA apply to HIPAA
All data is published for research
The data is used for training unless extra is paid for each request
No contractual agreement available
questions.e: Commercial terms exclude training with customer data by default; Regulatory needs are covered contractually.
questions.q_es: Un cliente del sector salud pregunta por el uso de sus datos. ¿Qué afirmación es adecuada para planes comerciales/API?

questions.q: Which principle should apply to the credentials used by an agent's tools?
o: Credentials with minimal scope, managed in a vault outside the prompt and rotated periodically
Include them in the system prompt so that the model can use them
Use the global administrator account
Share a single credential between all environments
questions.e: Never expose secrets to the model; the tooling layer injects them in a controlled way.
questions.q_es: ¿Qué principio debe aplicarse a las credenciales que usan las herramientas de un agente?

questions.q: It is necessary to demonstrate before an audit what an agent did and why. What to implement?
o: Immutable records of inputs, tool calls, approvals and outputs, with retention and access controls
Occasional screenshots
Nothing; models are not auditable
Only log errors
questions.e: Complete traceability supports compliance, incident investigation and continuous improvement.
questions.q_es: Se necesita demostrar ante auditoría qué hizo un agente y por qué. ¿Qué implementar?

questions.q: A team wants to prevent personal data from reaching the model in an analytics case. Which approach is preferable?
o: Minimizing and pseudonymizing/redacting PII before sending, re-identifying only where necessary and permitted
Send everything and ask the model to forget it
Encrypt the prompt with a key that the model does not know
Trust the model not to read the data
questions.e: Minimizing data at source is the most effective privacy control.
questions.q_es: Un equipo quiere evitar que datos personales lleguen al modelo en un caso de analítica. ¿Qué enfoque es preferible?

questions.q: What is red teaming in the context of an application with Claude?
o: Systematic adversarial testing to uncover security flaws, jailbreaks, data leaks, and unwanted behavior before deployment
A specialized sales team
A type of cache
A prompt compression technique
questions.e: Red teaming complements functional evaluations with abuse scenarios.
questions.q_es: ¿Qué es el red teaming en el contexto de una aplicación con Claude?

questions.q: A remote MCP server needs to access user data on your behalf. What authorization mechanism is the standard recommended by the specification?
o: OAuth 2.1 with user consent and limited scope tokens
Plain text passwords in settings
No authentication on internal networks
Share browser session
questions.e: The MCP specification defines OAuth-based authorization for HTTP transports.
questions.q_es: Un servidor MCP remoto necesita acceder a datos del usuario en su nombre. ¿Qué mecanismo de autorización es el estándar recomendado por la especificación?

questions.q: How does human oversight fit into an AI governance framework (e.g. to comply with high-risk regulations)?
o: Defining control points according to the risk of each decision, with those responsible and the ability to reverse or cancel
Just as an annual review
Not required if accuracy exceeds 90%
Only for the IT team
questions.e: Risk-proportionate supervision is a common requirement in regulatory frameworks and good practices.
questions.q_es: ¿Cómo encaja la supervisión humana en un marco de gobernanza de IA (p. ej. para cumplir regulaciones de alto riesgo)?

questions.q: An external vendor requests to integrate an MCP server of unknown origin into the production environment. What is the correct policy?
o: Only allow MCP servers approved after security review (allowlist), with fixed versions and monitoring
Accept any server that has good documentation
Install it and check it later if there are problems
Allow it only on weekends
questions.e: Controlling the supply chain of integrations reduces risks of malicious code or instructions.
questions.q_es: Un proveedor externo pide integrar un servidor MCP de origen desconocido en el entorno de producción. ¿Cuál es la política correcta?

questions.q: In a multi-agent research system, multiple subagents return contradictory findings. Which design handles it best?
o: That the orchestrator synthesizes with explicit criteria (sources, date, trust) and points out discrepancies or launches additional verification
Stay with the first response received
Average the texts
Discard all results
questions.e: The synthesis must resolve or expose conflicts with traceable criteria.
questions.q_es: En un sistema de investigación multiagente, varios subagentes devuelven hallazgos contradictorios. ¿Qué diseño lo gestiona mejor?

questions.q: Subagents in a system duplicate searches among themselves. What is the most likely cause and correction?
o: Ambiguous delegations from the orchestrator; define clear and distinct scopes and limits per subagent
Too many search tools; eliminate them
Low temperature; upload it
Streaming use; disable it
questions.e: Precise delegation instructions avoid overlaps.
questions.q_es: Los subagentes de un sistema duplican búsquedas entre sí. ¿Cuál es la causa más probable y la corrección?

questions.q: How to scale the effort of a multi-agent system according to the complexity of the query?
o: Include effort heuristics in the orchestrator prompt: few calls for simple queries, more subagents for extensive investigations
Always launch the maximum number of subagents
Always use a single agent without tools
Choose randomly
questions.e: Adjusting the number of agents and calls avoids overconsumption in simple tasks.
questions.q_es: ¿Cómo escalar el esfuerzo de un sistema multiagente según la complejidad de la consulta?

questions.q: To pass voluminous results between subagents without cluttering the orchestrator context, which pattern to use?
o: Have subagents write results to external storage (files/objects) and return references and summaries
Pass all full text through the orchestrator
Send results by email
Compress with base64 in the message
questions.e: Light references preserve fidelity and reduce information loss on the "broken phone."
questions.q_es: Para pasar resultados voluminosos entre subagentes sin saturar el contexto del orquestador, ¿qué patrón usar?

questions.q: A long-running agent crashes halfway through a 2-hour task. What architectural capacity is key?
o: Persistent state checkpoints that allow resuming from the last valid step
Always restart from the beginning
Increase `max_tokens`
Use temperature 0
questions.e: Resumption avoids losing work and costs; Errors accumulate in long processes.
questions.q_es: Un agente de larga duración falla a mitad de una tarea de 2 horas. ¿Qué capacidad arquitectónica es clave?

questions.q: When is a multi-agent architecture NOT recommended?
o: When the task requires tight shared context and many dependencies between steps (e.g. most coupled programming tasks)
When the task is broad and parallelizable
When there are many independent sources to investigate
When information exceeds the window of a single agent
questions.e: Multi-agents work best with independent subtasks; Highly coupled tasks suffer with coordination.
questions.q_es: ¿Cuándo NO es recomendable una arquitectura multiagente?

questions.q: What advantage does parallel processing of subagents offer with parallel tools?
o: Significant reduction in total time on extensive research tasks
Reduction of the total number of tokens
Eliminating the need for evaluation
Guarantee of deterministic results
questions.e: Parallelism reduces wall latency, although it usually increases overall consumption.
questions.q_es: ¿Qué ventaja ofrece el procesamiento paralelo de subagentes con herramientas en paralelo?

questions.q: An autonomous agent must operate in an environment with production data. What architectural security pattern to apply?
o: Separation of environments: the agent proposes changes in an isolated environment and a controlled process (review/CI) promotes them
Write to Production Shortcut
Run on a developer's laptop
Disable auditing to gain speed
questions.e: Isolate and promote through controls contains errors and abuses.
questions.q_es: Un agente autónomo debe operar en un entorno con datos de producción. ¿Qué patrón de seguridad arquitectónica aplicar?

questions.q: How to debug a multi-agent system whose behavior is non-deterministic?
o: With complete traces of decisions and interactions between agents, analyzing patterns in many executions instead of isolated cases
Running once and ending
Removing subagent prompts
Using only CPU metrics
questions.e: Aggregate trace analysis reveals systematic coordination failures.
questions.q_es: ¿Cómo depurar un sistema multiagente cuyo comportamiento es no determinista?

questions.q: In a system where a primary agent delegates code to a subagent, what defines the subagent to operate safely?
o: A restricted set of tools and permissions, according to their function
Same administrator permissions as the full system
Access to all corporate credentials
No restrictions so as not to limit your creativity
questions.e: Each agent must have the minimum skills necessary for their role.
questions.q_es: En un sistema donde un agente principal delega a un subagente de código, ¿qué define el subagente para operar con seguridad?

questions.q: What is the first step in building a useful evaluation suite for a new use case?
o: Define measurable success criteria and a set of representative cases (including borderline cases) with expected outcomes
Choose the most expensive model
Write the final prompt
Deploy to production and wait for complaints
questions.e: Without benchmark criteria and data there is no objective way to measure improvements.
questions.q_es: ¿Cuál es el primer paso para construir una suite de evaluación útil para un nuevo caso de uso?

questions.q: When is a code-based assessment preferable over LLM-as-a-judge?
o: When the result can be verified exactly (tag matching, schema validation, unit tests)
Never; LLM judge is always better
When evaluating tone or empathy
When there are no reference answers
questions.e: Code checks are fast, cheap and deterministic; the LLM judge covers subjective criteria.
questions.q_es: ¿Cuándo es preferible una evaluación basada en código frente a LLM-as-a-judge?

questions.q: How to increase the reliability of an LLM-as-a-judge?
o: Specific rubrics, structured output with reasoning, and calibration against a human-graded sample
Asking “is this answer good?” without criteria
Use the same prompt that generates the response
Raise the judge's temperature
questions.e: Clear rubrics and regular human validation reduce judge bias.
questions.q_es: ¿Cómo aumentar la confiabilidad de un LLM-as-a-judge?

questions.q: To evaluate an agent, what should be measured in addition to the final result?
o: The trajectory: tools used, number of steps, errors recovered, cost and time
Only the number of words in the final answer
CPU usage only
Nothing more, the final result is enough
questions.e: An agent may be right in an inefficient or risky way; The trajectory reveals problems.
questions.q_es: Para evaluar un agente, ¿qué conviene medir además del resultado final?

questions.q: Due to the variability of outputs, how are the results of an evaluation interpreted?
o: Running enough cases (and repetitions if applicable) to estimate success rates with intervals, not conclusions from a single attempt
One case is enough
Only the best attempt is considered
Variability does not affect
questions.e: Metrics such as pass@k or aggregate rates with sufficient samples give robust conclusions.
questions.q_es: Debido a la variabilidad de las salidas, ¿cómo se interpretan los resultados de una eval?

questions.q: After a prompt change, the global evaluation goes up 3% but a critical category goes down 15%. Which decision is correct?
o: Don't deploy without investigating: analyze regression by segment and correct before approving
Deploy because the average improved
Delete that category from the eval
Increase temperature
questions.e: Averages can hide serious regressions in important segments.
questions.q_es: Tras un cambio de prompt, la eval global sube 3 % pero una categoría crítica baja 15 %. ¿Qué decisión es correcta?

questions.q: Which source of test cases typically provides the most value over time?
o: Actual failures observed in production, anonymized and added to the regression set
Cases invented only at the beginning of the project
Examples copied from other unrelated sectors
Only easy cases
questions.e: Converting incidents into test cases prevents them from happening again.
questions.q_es: ¿Qué fuente de casos de prueba suele aportar más valor con el tiempo?

questions.q: What is a “golden dataset” in evaluation?
o: A curated set of inputs with outputs or benchmarks validated by experts
A gold price dataset
Unreviewed raw logs
A randomly generated dataset
questions.e: It is the stable basis of comparison to measure quality over time.
questions.q_es: ¿Qué es un «golden dataset» en evaluación?

questions.q: How to integrate evals into the business development cycle?
o: Execute them automatically in CI when prompts, tools or models change, with thresholds that block regressions
Run them manually once a year
Only when a customer complains
Do not integrate them so as not to slow down
questions.e: Evals as a quality gate prevent silent regressions.
questions.q_es: ¿Cómo integrar las evals en el ciclo de desarrollo empresarial?

questions.q: In production there are no truth labels for each interaction. How to monitor quality?
o: Sampling with human review, automatic sample judges, user signals (feedback, escalations) and business metrics
It is not possible to monitor quality without labels
Rely on latency alone
Count output tokens
questions.e: A combination of signals makes it possible to detect degradations without labeling everything.
questions.q_es: En producción no hay etiquetas de verdad para cada interacción. ¿Cómo monitorear la calidad?

questions.q: An assistant processes 2 million queries/month with an identical 8,000-token system prompt. Which optimization has the greatest direct impact on cost?
o: Stable prefix prompt caching
Increase `max_tokens`
Activate streaming
Change response format to XML
questions.e: Cache reads cost a fraction of the normal input, with big savings on repeated prefixes.
questions.q_es: Un asistente procesa 2 millones de consultas/mes con un prompt de sistema de 8 000 tokens idéntico. ¿Qué optimización tiene mayor impacto directo en costo?

questions.q: A nightly data enrichment pipeline has no latency requirement. What API to use?
o: Message Batches API (approx. 50% discount)
Synchronous calls with streaming
The Claude.ai web interface
Extended thinking with maximum budget
questions.e: Batch is the economical option for massive asynchronous loads.
questions.q_es: Un pipeline nocturno de enriquecimiento de datos no tiene requisito de latencia. ¿Qué API usar?

questions.q: What model “cascade” strategy optimizes cost without sacrificing quality?
o: Solve with a small model first and scale to a larger one only when confidence is low or the task is complex
Send all requests to all three models and choose the longest one
Always use the largest model
Choose random model
questions.e: Complexity routing reserves expensive models for cases that need it.
questions.q_es: ¿Qué estrategia de «cascada» de modelos optimiza costo sin sacrificar calidad?

questions.q: Users perceive slowness in long responses in a chat. What improves the experience without changing the model?
o: Streaming response to reduce time to first token
Increase `max_tokens`
Batch API
Delete the system prompt
questions.e: Streaming improves perceived latency.
questions.q_es: Los usuarios perciben lentitud en respuestas largas de un chat. ¿Qué mejora la experiencia sin cambiar el modelo?

questions.q: Rate limits are exceeded during peak hours. What actions are appropriate?
o: Queues with concurrency control, retries with backoff, prompt caching and, if necessary, request higher limits or dedicated capacity
Retry without waiting in loop
Create many accounts to bypass limits
Ignore 429 errors
questions.e: Managing demand and capacity legitimately avoids degradation.
questions.q_es: Se superan los rate limits en horas pico. ¿Qué acciones son adecuadas?

questions.q: What operational metrics are essential in an application dashboard with Claude?
o: Latency (p50/p95), miss rate by type, tokens and cost per request/user, cache hit rate and quality metrics
Only the number of registered users
Disk usage only
Just the number of different prompts
questions.e: The combination of performance, cost and quality allows you to operate efficiently.
questions.q_es: ¿Qué métricas operativas son esenciales en un tablero de una aplicación con Claude?

questions.q: One feature uses extended thinking with a very high budget for all queries, including trivial ones. What to adjust?
o: Adapt the reasoning effort/budget to the complexity, or activate it only on routes that require it
Increase the budget even more
Disable cache
Use only the largest model
questions.e: The extra reasoning adds latency and cost; should be used proportionally.
questions.q_es: Una funcionalidad usa extended thinking con un presupuesto muy alto para todas las consultas, incluidas las triviales. ¿Qué ajustar?

questions.q: An agent consumes many tokens for old tool results that are no longer relevant. What technique helps?
o: Context editing/cleanup or compaction that removes obsolete tool results
Double the results
Increase temperature
Convert results to images
questions.e: Removing obsolete content reduces cost and improves the focus of the model.
questions.q_es: Un agente consume muchos tokens por resultados de herramientas antiguos que ya no son relevantes. ¿Qué técnica ayuda?

questions.q: How should you budget the cost of a new use case before launching it?
o: Estimate input/output tokens by interaction with real samples, multiply by expected volume and consider cache, batch and mixture models
Assume a fixed cost per user without measuring
Wait for the first invoice
Count only output tokens
questions.e: A data-driven estimate avoids surprises and guides optimizations.
questions.q_es: ¿Cómo se debe presupuestar el costo de un nuevo caso de uso antes de lanzarlo?

questions.q: When deprecating a model version used in production, what is the proper procedure?
o: Plan the migration in advance: evaluate the successor model with the eval suite, adjust prompts and gradually deploy before the retirement date
Wait for it to stop working
Change model ID directly in production without testing
Keep the model retired indefinitely
questions.e: Models have published life cycles; Planned migration avoids incidents.
questions.q_es: Al retirarse (deprecation) una versión de modelo usada en producción, ¿cuál es el procedimiento adecuado?

questions.q: A customer on AWS requires that traffic to the model not traverse the public internet. What do you recommend?
o: Consume Claude via Amazon Bedrock with private VPC endpoints (AWS PrivateLink)
Use the public API with a personal VPN
Open firewall ports
Send requests by email
questions.e: Private connectivity keeps traffic within the cloud provider's network.
questions.q_es: Un cliente en AWS exige que el tráfico hacia el modelo no atraviese internet público. ¿Qué recomiendas?

questions.q: What advantage does a corporate LLM gateway layer provide over each application calling the provider directly?
o: Centralize authentication, policies, logging, limits, and cost attribution per team
Eliminates the need for prompts
Makes the model more accurate
Reduce the size of the context window
questions.e: The gateway is a control point for governance and observability.
questions.q_es: ¿Qué ventaja aporta una capa de gateway LLM corporativa frente a que cada aplicación llame directamente al proveedor?

questions.q: In an enterprise RAG assistant, each employee should only view documents to which they have permission. Where is control applied?
o: On retrieval: filter documents by user permissions before sending them to the model
At the prompt: "do not reveal confidential documents"
After generating the response, deleting sensitive words
Not necessary if the model is secure
questions.e: What does not enter the context cannot be filtered; ACLs are applied at the data layer.
questions.q_es: En un asistente RAG empresarial, cada empleado solo debe ver documentos a los que tiene permiso. ¿Dónde se aplica el control?

questions.q: For tools that access internal systems on behalf of an employee, which identity pattern is preferable?
o: Propagate the identity of the end user (on-behalf-of) so that each action respects their permissions
Use a service account with administrator privileges for everyone
Share credentials of a generic user
Disable internal authentication
questions.e: Prevents the agent from granting more access than the user has (confused deputy).
questions.q_es: Para herramientas que acceden a sistemas internos en nombre de un empleado, ¿qué patrón de identidad es preferible?

questions.q: A company needs general productivity (writing, analysis) for everyone and also a flow embedded in its CRM. What combination is reasonable?
o: Claude.ai Enterprise/Team for general productivity and an API integration for embedded flow
Only API for everything, building your own chat from scratch
Personal accounts only
Only Claude Code for all employees
questions.e: Buying the standard and building the differential is a common “build vs buy” approach.
questions.q_es: Una empresa necesita productividad general (redacción, análisis) para todos y además un flujo embebido en su CRM. ¿Qué combinación es razonable?

questions.q: How to attribute API spend to each business unit?
o: Use workspaces/keys separated by team or project and labeled in the gateway, with usage reports
Split the bill equally
Estimate based on number of employees
It is not possible
questions.e: Attribution by workspace or key allows precise showback/chargeback.
questions.q_es: ¿Cómo atribuir el gasto de API a cada unidad de negocio?

questions.q: Select the TWO practices for separating environments in an enterprise deployment.
o: Different keys and workspaces for development, staging and production
Spending limits and rate limits differentiated by environment
Use real production data in development without controls
Share the same API key in all environments
Deploy prompt changes directly to production
questions.e: Separation prevents tests from affecting production and facilitates cost control.
questions.q_es: Selecciona las DOS prácticas para separar entornos en un despliegue empresarial.

questions.q: Select the THREE considerations when choosing platform (Direct API, Bedrock or Vertex AI).
o: Availability of models and functions on each platform
Data residency requirements and regions
Integration with existing identity, network and cloud billing
The color of the supplier's logo
The number of followers on social networks
questions.e: The choice depends on capabilities, compliance and integration with the existing ecosystem.
questions.q_es: Selecciona las TRES consideraciones al elegir plataforma (API directa, Bedrock o Vertex AI).

questions.q: Select TWO practices to keep the index of an enterprise RAG system up to date.
o: Incremental ingestion pipelines that detect new, modified, and deleted documents
Also synchronize the permissions (ACL) of the documents
Manually reindex once a year
Keep deleted documents for more context
Ignore permission changes
questions.e: Outdated content and permissions lead to erroneous responses or information leaks.
questions.q_es: Selecciona las DOS prácticas para mantener actualizado el índice de un sistema RAG empresarial.

questions.q: Select the TWO metrics that should be defined before a phased deployment.
o: Adoption and usage metrics by area
Business impact metrics (time saved, quality)
Number of logos on the intranet
Number of AI meetings
Number of system prompt characters
questions.e: Measuring adoption and impact allows you to decide how to scale between phases.
questions.q_es: Selecciona las DOS métricas que conviene definir antes de un despliegue por fases.

questions.q: The output of the model is inserted into a web page and into SQL queries. What principle applies?
o: Treat model output as untrusted: escape/sanitize for HTML and use parameterized queries
Trust the output because it comes from a safe model
Execute the generated SQL directly with the administrator user
Disable HTML escaping
questions.e: Classic vulnerabilities (XSS, SQL injection) also apply to content generated by AI.
questions.q_es: La salida del modelo se inserta en una página web y en consultas SQL. ¿Qué principio aplica?

questions.q: What controls are appropriate for a sandbox where an agent executes generated code?
o: Isolation (container/VM), no sensitive credentials, restricted network, and resource and time limits
Run on production server with full access
Free access to the internet and internal network
No limits to avoid interrupting long tasks
questions.e: The sandbox contains the impact of erroneous or manipulated code.
questions.q_es: ¿Qué controles son adecuados para un sandbox donde un agente ejecuta código generado?

questions.q: What is a "confused deputy" problem in agents?
o: An agent with elevated privileges is induced to use those privileges on behalf of someone who should not have them
An agent who confuses two languages
A rounding error
An intermittent network failure
questions.e: It is mitigated with credentials limited to the user and authorization validation in each action.
questions.q_es: ¿Qué es un problema de «confused deputy» en agentes?

questions.q: What international standard defines a management system for artificial intelligence?
o: ISO/IEC 42001
ISO 9001
PCI DSS
questions.e: ISO/IEC 42001 specifies requirements for an AI management system; Anthropic has obtained this certification.
questions.q_es: ¿Qué norma internacional define un sistema de gestión para la inteligencia artificial?

questions.q: Prompt logs contain personal customer data. What practice applies?
o: Write PII in the logs, restrict access and define minimum necessary retention periods
Save everything indefinitely just in case
Publish logs for transparency
Disable all logging, including security traces
questions.e: Balancing observability with privacy requires minimization and access control.
questions.q_es: Los logs de prompts contienen datos personales de clientes. ¿Qué práctica aplica?

questions.q: Select THREE layers of in-depth defense against jailbreaks and abuse.
o: Entry sorting/filtering
Clear instructions and limits in the system prompt
Output monitoring and filtering
Increase temperature
Hide AI usage from users
questions.e: No layer is sufficient alone; Preventive and detective controls are combined.
questions.q_es: Selecciona las TRES capas de una defensa en profundidad contra jailbreaks y abuso.

questions.q: Select the appropriate TWO sources to assess Anthropic's supplier risk.
o: Certification and audit reports (e.g. SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001) from the Trust Center
Contractual agreements such as the DPA and commercial terms
Anonymous comments on forums
Social media advertising
Inside Sales Team Assumptions
questions.e: Due diligence is based on audited evidence and contractual commitments.
questions.q_es: Selecciona las DOS fuentes adecuadas para evaluar el riesgo de proveedor de Anthropic.

questions.q: Select the TWO measures to mitigate data exfiltration through prompt injection.
o: Restrict the destinations to which the agent can send data (allowlist of domains)
Require human approval for external communications
Allow the agent to follow instructions found on web pages
Give the agent access to all data so they have context
Disable action logs
questions.e: Cutting off the exit channel or requiring approval breaks the exfiltration chain.
questions.q_es: Selecciona las DOS medidas para mitigar la exfiltración de datos mediante prompt injection.

questions.q: Select the TWO actions that an AI incident response plan should include.
o: Procedure to quickly disable affected tools or functions
Trace analysis to determine scope and root cause
Delete all logs to prevent leaks
Wait for the problem to go away on its own
Blame the model and not document
questions.e: Rapid containment and investigation with evidence are pillars of incident response.
questions.q_es: Selecciona las DOS acciones que debe incluir un plan de respuesta a incidentes de IA.

questions.q: Select the TWO correct statements about the governance of the use of connectors and MCPs in the enterprise.
o: Administrators must approve which connectors are available
Permissions for each connector should be limited to what is necessary
Any user can install any server without patch
Connectors do not represent a risk because they are always read-only
Credentials can be shared between users
questions.e: Integrations expand the attack surface and require centralized control.
questions.q_es: Selecciona las DOS afirmaciones correctas sobre la gobernanza del uso de conectores y MCP en la empresa.

questions.q: When transferring a case from a triage agent to a specialist agent, what should the transfer include?
o: A structured summary: objective, key data, actions already taken, decisions and open questions
Only the user's last message
Nothing; the specialist starts from scratch
Complete raw history of all agents always
questions.e: A structured handover avoids repeating work and losing information.
questions.q_es: Al pasar un caso de un agente de triaje a un agente especialista, ¿qué debe incluir la transferencia?

questions.q: What modeling strategy typically balances quality and cost in an orchestrator-worker system?
o: A very capable model as an orchestrator and faster/economical models for limited subtasks
The smallest model for everything
The largest model for everything
A different model chosen at random per task
questions.e: Planning and synthesis benefit from more capacity; simple subtasks do not require it.
questions.q_es: ¿Qué estrategia de modelos suele equilibrar calidad y costo en un sistema orquestador-trabajadores?

questions.q: How should an orchestrator decide that he or she has enough information to complete the investigation?
o: With explicit sufficiency criteria (questions answered, minimum sources, budget) defined in your prompt
When the tokens run out
After exactly 100 searches always
When a subagent requests it without criteria
questions.e: Clear stopping criteria prevent both incomplete responses and over-investigation.
questions.q_es: ¿Cómo debe decidir un orquestador que tiene suficiente información para terminar la investigación?

questions.q: A subagent fails in one of 8 subtasks. Which behavior is preferable?
o: Isolate the failure: retry or reassign that subtask and, if not possible, continue marking the gap in the result
Abort the entire system
Invent the missing result
Ignore the error without mentioning it
questions.e: Fault tolerance with transparency maintains the usefulness of the result.
questions.q_es: Un subagente falla en una de 8 subtareas. ¿Qué comportamiento es preferible?

questions.q: Why is a multi-agent system usually evaluated by its final state and not by an exact sequence of steps?
o: Because different valid paths can reach a good result; requiring exact steps penalizes correct solutions
Why steps cannot be recorded
Because the final state is always the same
Because it is cheaper not to keep traces
questions.e: The result is evaluated and trajectories are analyzed to detect inefficiencies or risks.
questions.q_es: ¿Por qué suele evaluarse un sistema multiagente por su estado final y no por una secuencia exacta de pasos?

questions.q: Select the TWO ways to share information between agents that scale well.
o: A shared state/artifact store with references
Structured messages with defined schemas
Copy all history of all agents to each message
Communication in free text without formatting or validation
Global variables in memory without concurrency control
questions.e: Structure and references reduce tokens and ambiguity.
questions.q_es: Selecciona las DOS formas de compartir información entre agentes que escalan bien.

questions.q: Select the TWO practices to maintain consistent behavior between agents.
o: Shared instruction fragments (style, policies) reused in prompts
Common schemes for outputs that are exchanged
Each agent with contradictory policies
Avoid documenting roles
Change prompts independently without evaluation
questions.e: Consistency is designed with common components and data contracts.
questions.q_es: Selecciona las DOS prácticas para mantener comportamiento coherente entre agentes.

questions.q: Select TWO signs that a change in the orchestrator prompt had undesired effects.
o: Notable increase in subagents launched or tokens per task
Score drop in final result evaluations
Interface color changed
Repository name changed
Server time changed
questions.e: Small changes to the orchestrator can greatly alter the emergent behavior.
questions.q_es: Selecciona las DOS señales de que un cambio en el prompt del orquestador tuvo efectos no deseados.

questions.q: Select the TWO ways to distribute permissions in a multi-agent system.
o: Research agents with read-only tools
An action agent with writing tools subject to approval
All agents with administrator permissions
Randomly assigned permissions
The agent with the least context with the most permissions
questions.e: Separating read and write reduces the risk if an agent is tampered with.
questions.q_es: Selecciona las DOS formas de distribuir permisos en un sistema multiagente.

questions.q: Select the TWO situations where a multi-agent system provides the most value.
o: Extensive investigations with many independent directions
Tasks whose volume of information exceeds what can fit in a single context
A short answer to a simple question
